items.quote: Raymond James Financial has introduced Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, which integrate traditional and alternative investments within risk-based portfolios for financial advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients

items.text: Raymond James's Private Wealth Advisor designation program targets advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients, which the firm generally defines as those with at least $5 million in investable assets; nearly 450 advisors had earned the designation as of September 2026.
items.quote: advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets. As of September 2026, nearly 450 advisors have earned the designation

items.text: The Private Wealth Advisor designation program has been a key recruitment and retention signal for Raymond James as it competes for advisors who build practices around affluent households.
items.quote: The program has been a key recruitment and retention signal for the firm as it competes for advisors who build practices around affluent households.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry said the firm's private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform supports advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: our private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform supports advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry said the firm developed private capital raising expertise and bespoke private investment alternatives for ultra-high net worth clients in response to growing demand.
items.quote: In response to growing demand for private investment product alternatives for ultra-high net worth clients, we further developed the firm's private capital raising expertise and brought in bespoke private investment alternatives for such clients.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry said the firm remains focused in the private wealth space on providing education, training, accreditation, and enhanced capabilities and product solutions so advisors can meet the needs of their most sophisticated clients.
items.quote: in the private wealth space, we remain focused on providing education, training, accreditation, and enhanced capabilities and product solutions to allow advisors to meet the needs of their most sophisticated clients

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry said the firm announced a new leadership structure for its private capital business to help high-net-worth-focused advisors better serve their clients with bespoke private investment alternatives.
